result.description:
We have casual roles available for experienced Early Childhood Teachers (ECTs), Diploma and Certificate level educators plus roles for those just starting their early childhood / childcare teaching careers, with a minimum Certificate III qualification.  
  With dedicated work-life partners taking our educators on their career journey, it's the easiest way to start or continue your education career.      
  We Are Looking For:   
 
  Experienced Educators:  Proven experience working within early childhood settings, bringing strong classroom engagement, supervision skills, and a reliable work ethic. 
  Qualified Professionals:  A completed Certificate III, Diploma, or Early Childhood Teaching (ECT) qualification in Early Years 
  Engaging Program Delivery:  Motivation to implement high-quality, engaging, and activity-based learning programs that inspire young minds and hear young voices. 
  Curriculum Knowledge:  A strong dedication to understanding and implementing the Early Years Learning Framework (EYLF) and National Quality Standards (NQS). 
  Adaptability:  Flexibility and willingness to travel to various early learning services around the  Bundoora  and surrounding areas. 
  Engaging Personality:  A warm, vibrant, and approachable nature that allows you to easily connect, collaborate, and build strong relationships with fellow educators, centre staff, and families. 
 
  Why Join The Randstad Team?   
 
  Total Flexibility & Control:  Manage your calendar, choose your shifts, and select your locations-all seamlessly through our exclusive myRandstad app. 
  Access to Your Pay When You Need It:  Say goodbye to the pay cycle wait. We offer our team members access to their earned wages as they need it, providing vital financial flexibility. 
  Exclusive Rewards Program:  Enjoy fantastic discounts and savings on everyday essentials like groceries, food delivery, entertainment, and more. 
  Dedicated Support:  You will never be on your own with 24/7 support. Along side our Talent Partners to provide guidance throughout your application, onboarding, and entire working journey. 
 
  About you:  
 
  Qualified Certificate III or Diploma in Early Childhood Education and Care or a Bachelor of Education in Early Childhood / Childcare  
  Willingness to travel to different locations around your area  
  Able to implement quality, engaging, and activity-based programs  
  An understanding of the Early Learning Framework  
  Early Childhood Teachers must have a willingness to obtain their relevant state based teachers registration   
  Australian work rights and a willingness to gain you state based working with children's check and  Food Handling Certificate.  
  Committed to Child Safeguarding and understanding of Mandatory Reporting responsibilities  
  Willingness to complete national mandatory child safety training  
  Able to provide contact details of two most recent professional referees who have managed you and can speak to your ability to work with children (eg Director, Coordinator, Area Manager)  
 
   
  Partner with us today:   Skip the queue! Download the my Randstad app via the app or play store to apply for jobs or pick up casual shifts in just a few clicks - quick, easy, and on your terms! Get access to the compliance documents straight away which means we can start processing your application as soon as you supply everything   Or   
  Click    APPLY    and your details will arrive with the Candidate Service Team who will send you an application pack to complete  
   
  Randstad Education is committed to the safety of children and we have a zero tolerance approach to all forms of child abuse or neglect.   
  We aim to be the easiest agency to work with and promise to contact you after your application has been received. Apply today for a free and fast path to work.  

 At Randstad, we are passionate about providing equal employment opportunities and embracing diversity to the benefit of all. We actively encourage applications from any background. 
   
    Please  click here  to apply.
